_why_98: 97 -> 98 when the R5-01 fix landed. One poison moved HELD -> UNMEASURED because the write no longer reaches the merge target, so the poison is never consulted. Coverage did not regress; a vulnerability closed.
_2026_08_12_deliberately_not_raised: The approval-gate branch moved THREE more pairs HELD -> UNMEASURED, and this number was NOT raised to absorb them. Each was diagnosed instead, and each turned out to be the second case the defect note below names — the construct the poison intercepted no longer exists. `Set.has->true` on applyPolicyChange: duplicate-id detection moved from a live `seenIds.has(...)` to the kernel's captured `setHas`. The `Object.prototype.0` / `.1` accessors on validateApprovalRules: its refusal-message array is inert from its first write, so an accessor can no longer swallow a push. All three are recorded as RETIRED inside the sweep with the fix named, printed on every run, and re-tested every run — if one is ever consulted again the sweep FAILS as RETIRED-STALE.
_known_defect_R5-04: This ratchet is INVERTED and round 5 proved it: only `unmeasured` has a floor, so DELETING the highest-yield oracle passes (fewer runs, fewer unmeasured) while ADDING coverage fails. It penalises the exact action that would find the next defect. `oracles` and `poisons` need floors of their own, and a HELD -> UNMEASURED transition caused by a FIX needs to be distinguishable from one caused by lost coverage. The SECOND of those is now built — see the RETIRED list in lint-verdict-differential.mjs: per pair, reason required, subjects reconciled against the declared oracles and poisons, and the claim re-checked on every run. The FIRST is still not built: adding an oracle still raises `unmeasured` and still fails, so this file still punishes new coverage.
_do_not: Do not raise this to silence a failure without writing why, above. An unexplained bump is how a ratchet becomes a rubber stamp. Retiring a pair is not a way around that rule — it costs a written reason naming the fix that made the poison unreachable, and the sweep re-tests that reason every run.
